task_completion.description: Agent successfully logs into the Odoo instance.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Odoo dashboard or App switcher is visible after entering credentials (admin/admin).

task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the Employees or Departments module.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Employees' app is open, and the breadcrumbs or sidebar indicate the user is in the Employees/Departments section.

task_completion.description: Agent initiates the creation of a new department.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'New' or 'Create' button is clicked, and a blank department form appears with fields for 'Department Name' and 'Manager'.

task_completion.description: Agent enters the correct department name.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text 'Product Management' is typed into the Department Name field.

task_completion.description: Agent selects Tina Williamson as the manager.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The name 'Tina Williamson' is selected from the dropdown or typed into the Manager field.

task_completion.description: Agent saves the new department record.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save' icon (cloud or disk) is clicked, or the form transitions from an editable state to a read-only view showing the saved record.

integrity.description: The agent used the Odoo web interface rather than executing database commands via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks, and typing within the browser window rather than just terminal output.

integrity.description: The agent did not bypass the UI by navigating directly to a final 'success' URL without interaction.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the step-by-step process of filling out the form.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual search/dropdown for the manager name.
integrity.visual_evidence: The dropdown list showing 'Tina Williamson' as an existing employee is visible during the selection process.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The Odoo instance is at http://localhost:8069. Credentials are admin/admin. The department to be created is 'Product Management'. The manager 'Tina Williamson' is a pre-existing employee in the demo data and must be selected in the Manager field of the new department record.
